verdict.rationale: The pack never documents an HTTP event-ingestion endpoint for server-to-server tracking, nor its authentication or delivery guarantees. The Public API, with its token authentication and rate limits, is a workspace-management CRUD API, not an event-collection endpoint, so it is an adjacent feature. The analytics.track snippet and the language list point to client SDKs rather than a documented HTTP ingestion API. The Centrifuge delivery-job comments describe outbound delivery to destinations, not guarantees for inbound ingestion.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can send events server-to-server through a documented HTTP ingestion API with authentication and delivery guarantees
